description: Write a redacted copy of a local PDF with detected sensitive text permanently removed and verified gone. Never modifies the input.

detect.description: Any of ssn, card, email, phone. Omit for all

license.description: Pro licence token; falls back to BLACKOUT_LICENSE

output_path.description: Defaults to <input>-redacted.pdf; must not be the input

overwrite.description: Allow replacing an existing output. Default false

path.description: Absolute path to a PDF on this machine

name: redact_pdf
